news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.02 loss per share (vs ₹0.14 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.02 loss per share (improved from ₹0.14 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.18b (up 141% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹6.02m (loss narrowed 84% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 25% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 39% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Less than 1 year of cash runway based on free cash flow trend (-₹14m free cash flow). news.title: Wardwizard Foods and Beverages Limited Announces Resignation of Bhoomi Talati as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective February 16, 2026
news.body: Wardwizard Foods and Beverages Limited announced that Ms. Bhoomi Talati (ICSI Membership No: FCS-12828) has tendered her resignation from the position of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer (Key Managerial Personnel - KMP) of the Company for better growth and career opportunity and she will be relieved from responsibilities being Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with effect from February 16, 2026 (after the closing of business hours). Ms. Bhoomi Talati has also confirmed that there is no other material reason other than mentioned in her resignation letter.
